formdata.description: Optional when only one kling/accounts configured. However, if you have multiple accounts configured, this parameter becomes required.
Required, URL of the avatar image. Upload via POST /assets.
Optional, display name for the avatar. Max 30 chars. AI auto-generates if not provided.
Optional, description/prompt for the avatar. Max 2000 chars. Used as default when generating avatar videos. AI auto-generates if not provided.
Optional, avatar use case. Supported: all, social_media, entertainment, advertising_marketing (default), business, education, virtual_idol. AI auto-detects if not provided.
Optional, TTS speaker ID. Use GET /tts/voices for available speakers. AI recommends if not provided.
Optional, speech speed. Range: 0.8-2.0. Default: 1.
Optional, speech emotion. Supported: neutral (default), happy, angry, sad, fearful, disgusted, surprised.

request.description:
[Create Avatar 2.0](https://useapi.net/docs/api-kling-v1/post-kling-avatars)

Most fields are optional and will be automatically populated using AI if not provided.

formdata.description: Optional when only one kling/accounts configured. However, if you have multiple accounts configured, this parameter becomes required.
Avatar ID from GET /avatars. Provide either avatarId OR imageUrl, not both.
Direct URL to an avatar image. Provide either avatarId OR imageUrl, not both.
URL of pre-recorded audio file. Provide either audioUrl OR text, not both.
Text to convert to speech. Max 5000 chars. Requires speakerId. Provide either audioUrl OR text, not both.
Required when using text. Use GET /tts/voices for available speakers.
Optional, speech speed. Range: 0.8-2.0. Default: 1.
Optional, speech emotion. Supported: neutral (default), happy, angry, sad, fearful, disgusted, surprised.
Optional, avatar behavior/appearance description. Max 2000 chars. Default: Natural speaking.
Optional, video generation mode. Supported: std (default), pro.
Optional, max concurrent jobs. Range: 1-50.
Optional, callback URL for generation progress/result.
Optional, reference identifier for callback.

request.description:
[Generate Avatar 2.0 video](https://useapi.net/docs/api-kling-v1/post-kling-avatars-video)

Supports both pre-recorded audio (audioUrl) and text-to-speech (text + speakerId).
